name: Put Christmas Tree Butterfly (1-3-2)
summary: Mirror of the call christmas tree in puts - buy 1 higher, sell 3 middle, buy 2 lower - a moderately bearish tent with capped downside if the geometry is set correctly.

legs.strike_rule: strike C: at or just ITM put (~0.55 delta), the highest strike
strike B = C - W, placed at the downside price target
strike A = B - W/2 (lower wing sized so net delta below A is zero)

max_profit: at strike B: (C - B) x 100 minus net debit (or plus net credit)
max_loss: upside: the net debit (zero on a credit entry). Downside below A: compute numerically from the 1-3-2 geometry - must be verified as capped before routing
breakevens: upper BE = C - net debit per share; lower BE computed from the exact geometry at entry

greeks.delta: negative at entry (~-0.15 to -0.30 per unit)
greeks.theta: positive when spot is above B

when_to_use: Moderately bearish with a target at strike B, IV rank >= 30, exploiting rich put skew at the 3x short strike.
entry_rules: Strike B at a concrete downside target (20-day low, measured move, or spot x (1 - 0.75 x expected move))
Compute the payoff numerically; REJECT if downside risk below A exceeds 1.5% of equity
Net debit <= 25% of (C - B), or a net credit
Verify leg-by-leg that every short put is covered; otherwise it is a level 4 structure and Alpaca will reject it
management_rules: Take profit at 50% of max profit
Close at 21 DTE regardless of P/L
Loss stop at 1.0x the net debit (or 2x the credit)
Close if spot falls more than 0.5 x (B - A) below strike B
exit_rules: Force-close by 15:45 ET on expiration day, always
Close immediately if the 3x short put strike is ITM by more than 0.25 x (B - A), or its extrinsic < $0.10, or its delta <= -0.85
300 shares of purchase obligation per unit if assigned - on a $50k account a single assignment on a $200 underlying is a $60,000 debit; this is the hard cap on sizing
assignment_risk: Three short puts per unit = obligation to buy 300 shares per unit. Assignment can exceed account equity on higher-priced underlyings. Size by assignment notional, not just by max loss.
buying_power: Broker-computed max modeled loss when fully covered.
liquidity_needs: OI >= 500 at all strikes; 3x short strike must be very liquid.
common_mistakes: Sizing off max loss and ignoring assignment notional; not computing the lower-tail payoff; treating it as a normal butterfly.
zero_dte_notes: Not recommended - 3 short puts into an expiring session.
family: four-leg structures (iron condors, iron butterflies, condors, double calendars/diagonals, boxes, jelly rolls, conversions/reversals, double verticals, double ratio spreads)
